1.3 Executive Summary
F
O
R
M
This reporter arrived at the Rokeby site on January 18, 2021. The customer had already 
locked out units 2 and 3, as well as removed the burner center sections from both units 
before the reporter’s arrival. The inspection on unit 2 was completed on January 19, 2021. 
This reporter left site on January 21, 2021. 
Overall, the unit was found in good condition. A third-party borescope inspection arranged by 
the customer was completed on the turbine and compressor sections of this unit during this 
inspection. The borescope inspectors noted some potential indications on the leading edge 
of some of the row 1 turbine vanes. This reporter inspected these potential indications and 
found them to be within acceptance criteria. The row 1 turbine vanes are thermal barrier 
coated, and only visual inspections were performed.
Rub marks were found on four of the row F turbine stator heat shields at the 2 o'clock 
position. The stator heat shields in this location were found to have rub marks on the 
previous inspection.

3.5.1 Turbine Blades and Vanes
F
O
R
M
Part Condition: Good
Part Description: 
A total of three of the turbine row 1 vanes showed potential indications in the coating of the 
leading edge of the vane. See attached pictures for more detail. The affected vanes are 
numbers 32, 39 and 42. Vane 32 (12 o’clock) has one 6mm long potential indication on the 
leading edge of the air foil. Vane 39 (2 o’clock) has one 4mm long potential indication on the 
leading edge, suction side and two 1.5mm potential indications on the leading edge of the air 
foil. Vane number 42 (3 o’clock) has one 3mm long potential indication, and one 2mm 
potential indication, both on the leading edge of the air foil. Some rub marks were found on 4 
of the row F stator heat shields at the 2 o’clock position. The rubbed heat shields are 
numbers 46, 47, 49 and 50. These stator heat shields were found to be rubbed at the 
previous inspection. Row L rotor heat shield gaps were visually inspected and found to be 
uniform. 
A third party borescope inspection was performed on the turbine. See customer report for 
any borescope findings.
Recommendation Description: 
Monitor potential indications and rub marks on future inspections.
Vane 32 01
